title:
An epic that synchronizes and reset charts based on `chartId` in the payload.

When triggered by the `COMBINE_CHART` action:
- Sets the synchronize config in chart to `false`
- Resets the chart height and chart grid configuration to default

When triggered by the `SPLIT_CHART` action:
- Sets the synchronize config in chart to `true`
- Sets the chart height and chart grid configuration to synchronized mode

Expected payload:
- chartId (required): if not provided no action will be dispatched
- synchronizedChartHeight (optional): If not provided, calculated based on the number of series and events in chart
- defaultChartHeight (optional): Height to use for combined chart mode (defaults to 400)
name: UiSdlEpicSynchronizeChart
